name: Phocos Any-Grid PSW-H (RS-232 / RS-485)
description: Phocos Any-Grid PSW-H hybrid inverters over the RS-232 port (supplied cable) or RS-485: live readings, mode, fault code and status, up to nine paralleled units, settings, defaults and firmware. Read-only. Needs firmware 06.11 or later.
notes: Built from Phocos's RS-232 PhocosLink command document (2020-12-14), used with Phocos's permission; each request and reply carries a CRC-16/XMODEM. QPIGS and QPGS0 are read every poll; everything else is optional: asked now and then, only if a field of it is mapped, and not again for a while if the unit does not answer or is not there (a parallel unit answers with a zero serial number). Units QPGS1 to QPGS9 are numbered by the unit, and the document warns that the numbering can change when units restart: tie readings to the serial number. A fault code of 00 is shown as 'No fault' (the document lists no code for it). Setting names (charger priority CSO, SNU, OSO; battery types, output modes) are those of the PhocosLink app, which agree with the document where it names them (battery types 4 to 7 come from the app only). QID and QMOD are not polled: the serial number and mode are already in QPGS0. Not yet checked against a unit.
